name: com.uee03.pretzel.ui
description: UI Toolkit helpers: element factories, fades, screen navigation, safe area, toasts, world-space helpers, a screen controller base and Editor UI building blocks.

samples.description: Two screens with UIControllerBase, every element factory, fades, UIHoverFade, UIDocumentFader and an Editor window for the Editor-only factories.
Screen navigation with UIScreenStack, a modal dialog, toasts, a safe-area root and a name tag that follows a 3D object.
An editor window and a custom inspector built with EditorUI and InspectorBase.
